blocks.tamil_translation: is the best deed of all.) Hazrat Abu Fatimah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أَُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَفْضَلُ الصَّدَقَاتِ ظِلُّ فُسْطَاطٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، وَمَنِيحَةُ خَادِمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، أَوْ طَرُوقَةُ فَحْلٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب صحيح، باب ما جاء في فضل الخدمة في سبيل الله، رقم:١٦٢٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The best of charity is setting up a tent in the path of Allah Ta'ala to arrange for rest during the day, appointing a useful servant in the path of Allah Ta'ala, and giving a young camel in the path of Allah Ta'ala” (through which it can be of use for things such as travel).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ لَمْ يَغْزُ أَوْ يُجَهِّزْ غَازِياً أَوْ يَخْلُفْ غَازِياً فِي أَهْلِهِ بِخَيْرٍ، أَصَابَهُ اللهُ بِقَارِعَةٍ. قَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ: قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب كراهة ترك الغزو، رقم:٢٥٠٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever neither strives in the path of Allah, nor makes travel arrangements for one going in the path of Allah, nor is a help and support in the affairs of the families of those who strive and have gone in the path of Allah Ta'ala, some hardship from Allah Ta'ala will come upon him.” Yazid ibn Abd Rabbih, one of the narrators of this hadith, says, “The hardship that reaches him is a hardship that will come before the Day of Qiyamah.”
